# Cloudflare Agents SDK (Cloudflare)

Build stateful AI agents on Cloudflare with the agents package.

- Source: https://github.com/cloudflare/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudflare/skills/main/skills/agents-sdk/SKILL.md
- Author: Cloudflare
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/cloudflare-agents-sdk-cloudflare-5756914e

Helps Claude build, debug or review apps that use Cloudflare's Agents SDK: defining agent classes, routing, state, scheduling, WebSocket and chat APIs, and the React client hooks. It starts by checking the package is installed and the Wrangler config is right. Reference files cover each part of the SDK. Uses npm packages such as agents and @cloudflare/ai-chat.

**Try asking:**
- "Build a chat agent on Cloudflare Agents with persistent memory"
- "Add a scheduled task to my Cloudflare agent"
- "Why is my agent's state not persisting?"
